name: Content Digest – YouTube, X and newsletter summaries

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ Start here
All configuration lives in the **Settings** node: the YouTube channels, X accounts and newsletter senders to follow, the Telegram chat and the model.

## ▶️ YouTube
Channel → uploads playlist → latest videos → only the ones not seen before → transcript (Supadata, optional)

## 𝕏 X posts
twitterapi.io: latest posts per account, including images

## ✉️ Newsletters
Gmail search for the configured senders

## 🤖 Summary
One Claude request for all new items (text + X images); the reply goes to Telegram in chunks of up to 4096 characters
